name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, data source, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement, triage

## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution
Describe the approach and how it fits the project's scientific principles
(observed/inferred/GT separation, abstention under uncertainty, provenance).

## Alternatives considered
List any alternative approaches and why they were rejected.

## Scientific / data impact
- [ ] Introduces new data products
- [ ] Changes ingestion contract (`GEOTIFF_INPUT_CONTRACT.md`)
- [ ] Affects leak-free guarantees
- [ ] Requires new ground-truth source

## Implementation sketch
High-level steps, affected modules, estimated effort.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Tests added / updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] REPO_ANALYSIS.md updated
